# Published plugins

<!-- generated by `chock marketplace build`; edits are overwritten -->

**54 policies are published here: 42 enforce in this client, 12 are advisory.**

A guard package ships a guard script and a stdlib-only adapter, hooked at `PreToolUse`, and can deny a shell command before the client runs it. It fails open when `git` or a usable `bash` is unavailable, and exits 2 when no Python 3.11+ runs. When the guard itself crashes, the hook asks for confirmation rather than allowing silently. A gate package ships the policy's gate and a stdlib-only runner, hooked at `PreToolUse` and `Stop`, judging the file a write would create and then re-reading what the turn left on disk. It needs `git` and a Python 3.11+; with no working Python it exits 2, without git a fail-open client allows silently, and a gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. 4 of these packages ship both: the policy has a guard and a gate, and each runs at its own hooks as described. An advisory package ships skill text; nothing stops a violation.
